images.name: WarehouseWearDecals
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game decal atlas for a PS1-style surreal industrial warehouse. Generate a square 1024x1024 RGBA texture with a genuinely transparent background. Four independent square decal regions in an exact 2 by 2 grid, no drawn grid. Each region has ample fully transparent padding, at least 48 pixels away from its quadrant edges. Top-left: a long vertical branching rust-and-damp drip running down from a corroded joint, dark brown muted ochre with grey-green dirty water stain. Top-right: a broad asymmetrical black-brown oily grime deposit with ragged scraped edge, flat and thin, no pool reflections. Bottom-left: several fine branching concrete hairline cracks with a tiny amount of grey grime in the crevices, an irregular horizontal cluster. Bottom-right: abraded grey-green industrial paint, worn scratches, chipped patches and small rust specks, an irregular horizontal cluster. Render each as a flat surface marking photographed directly overhead, no perspective, no shadows cast onto the transparent background, no lighting baked into the stains. Matte muted readable industrial texture with restrained hand-painted early-3D-game detail, not glossy or hyperreal. No text, symbols, labels, objects, skin, flesh, blood, logo, watermark or border. No contamination from one quadrant into another. This atlas is sampled onto real wall and floor geometry under in-game lighting.
images.layout_edit: Edit this production decal atlas only to enforce its UV layout. Keep the same four designs, muted industrial material colors, transparent background, flat lighting and fine texture style. The canvas must remain square. It is an exact 2 by 2 grid of equal square UV cells. Shorten and reposition the TOP-LEFT rust drip so every visible pixel of it is entirely inside the top-left cell. Leave a fully transparent empty horizontal band, at least 64 pixels high, centered at the halfway height of the image, and a fully transparent empty vertical band, at least 64 pixels wide, centered at the halfway width. Leave at least 48 pixels of transparent padding at every outer canvas edge. Each design stays inside its own quadrant: rusty vertical drip top-left, oily grime top-right, fine concrete cracks bottom-left, chipped green-grey paint bottom-right. No visible pixel crosses into another quadrant or touches a grid boundary. No drawn grid, no border, no text or new details. Preserve real RGBA transparency.
